method: All retained413fc0 instructions, no calls or arithmetic stubs. Compares every byte of full caller record storage including records beyond count, prefix/suffix guards and unchanged globals. Any-nonzero gate, zero counts, signed status skips, signed-short extremes, exact/coarse-coincident origin, wrapped shift/add and positive-to-negative byte truncation. All declared signed-short coordinate and signed32 strength inputs have positive max-square divisor after zero replacement, so IDIV is nonzero and quotient fits. No original process execution.
